findings.title: Pre-existing `ap` (awesome_print) debug statements execute on every validation/scoring call in production
findings.description: ValidateAiSummaryGeneration#call emits ~12 `ap` (awesome_print) debug prints on every invocation (lines 10-22, 34-37), including candidate/org ids and credit balances. The scoring services under review do the same (extract_criteria.rb:18-19,47-48,78-79,91-92,145,150,154; score_job_application.rb:15-16,60,69,75-77,84,129,138). These fire in production for every manual/auto/bulk review path — the zero-criteria guard added by this feature (validate_ai_summary_generation.rb:30) sits amid this noise. This is NOT introduced by the feature: it is a pre-existing, codebase-wide pattern in the AI-scoring domain (only line 30 was added to this validator; the scoring-service edits are pure constant substitutions). Reported for the record only; no actionable feature defect.
findings.recommendation: No feature action. If the team wants to reduce production log noise / id leakage, strip `ap` calls from the AI-scoring pipeline in a separate cleanup — out of scope for this feature.
